name: Anathoth
overview: Anathoth is a significant city in the territory of Benjamin, known as the birthplace of the prophet Jeremiah and other notable figures such as Abiezer and Jehu. Scripture identifies Anathoth as a city of refuge and highlights its inhabitants, including those who returned from Babylonian captivity, numbering 128 men as recorded in Ezra and Nehemiah. The city is also noted for the opposition Jeremiah faced from some of its residents who threatened his life for prophesying in the name of the Lord, underscoring its complex spiritual and historical role in biblical narrative.
